Treasury Transparency

Full visibility into the community's assets and the collective decision-making process for resource allocation.

Purpose of the Treasury

The Wenode Treasury exists to ensure the long-term sustainability and growth of the Mesh. It is a community-owned reserve used to fund infrastructure, R&D, and network expansion according to the priorities set by the DAO.

Governance & Control

DAO Veto & ApprovalAll major Treasury allocations require a formal DAO proposal and a successful community vote. The Governance Board supervises the execution, but the power to release funds rests with the Souls of the Mesh.

Spending Categories

Infrastructure

Funding for sovereign servers, power systems, and mesh expansion.

Development

Grants and payments for core protocol and AI LLM development.

Ecosystem

Marketing, community initiatives, and strategic partnerships.

Operations

Legal, compliance, and essential administrative costs.

Transparency Rules

  • All transactions are recorded on-chain and publicly auditable.
  • Monthly financial reports must be published by the Governance Board.
  • Critical spending triggers automated DAO notifications.
  • A multi-sig arrangement ensures no single entity can access funds.
